setting.de: Ein Besuch beim Kinderarzt in Görz. Seit gestern tut dir der Bauch weh, und dir ist ein bisschen heiß. Mama ist bei dir.
setting.sl: Obisk pri pediatru v Gorici. Od včeraj te boli trebuh in malo ti je vroče. Mama je s tabo.
setting.en: A visit to the paediatrician in Gorizia. Your tummy has hurt since yesterday, and you feel a bit hot. Mamma is with you.

role: Dottor Bassi, a calm, gentle paediatrician in Gorizia. Speaks slowly and smiles; one simple question at a time; says it is nothing serious and {learner} will soon be well. Says tu. Nothing frightening (no needles); asks nothing personal.

goals.it: Di' che cosa ti fa male

goals.en: Say whether you have a fever

opener_sl: Ciao, {learner}! Siediti qui. Dimmi, che cosa ti fa male?

opener_en.de: Hallo, {learner}! Setz dich hierher. Sag mal, was tut dir weh?
opener_en.sl: Živjo, {learner}! Sedi sem. Povej mi, kaj te boli?
opener_en.en: Hello, {learner}! Sit here. Tell me, what hurts?

vocabulary_hints.sl: Sì, ho un po' di febbre.

en.de: Ja, ich habe ein bisschen Fieber.
en.en: Yes, I have a bit of a fever.
No, I don't have a fever.
